summary: Enterprise AI in 2026 is dominated by cloud-native model API aggregators that let corporations access multiple foundation models (GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, Mistral, and more) through a single managed API while keeping data inside their own cloud security perimeter. There is no single winner: the best fit is usually driven by an enterprise's existing cloud footprint, required model breadth, data residency needs, and compliance obligations. AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/Foundry, and Google Vertex AI lead adoption, with Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx, Cloudflare Workers AI, and Oracle Cloud AI serving data-centric, regulated, edge, and OCI-aligned niches respectively.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and privacy: prompts, completions, and fine-tuning data stay within the company's own cloud tenant/VPC and are not used to train the provider's base models, unlike calling consumer vendor APIs directly.
Compliance and governance: built-in audit logging, access controls (IAM/RBAC), encryption, and certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR/EU residency) that satisfy regulated industries.
Model choice behind one API: swap or multi-source Claude, Llama, Mistral, GPT, Gemini, etc. without re-architecting integrations or signing separate contracts with each model vendor.

Single billing and existing cloud contracts: consolidate AI spend under existing enterprise agreements, committed-use discounts, and procurement relationships instead of managing many vendor invoices.
Integrated enterprise tooling: native connections to corporate data (RAG), identity, networking (private endpoints/VPC), monitoring, and guardrails reduce build time and security review burden.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (input/output) on-demand, plus Provisioned Throughput for reserved capacity; batch pricing discounts available.
key_features: Widest model choice behind one API (30+ foundation models)
VPC/PrivateLink private connectivity
CloudTrail audit logs and IAM access control
Fine-tuning and continued pre-training support
Bedrock Guardrails and Knowledge Bases (RAG)
Bedrock Agents for tool/function calling
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already on AWS wanting the broadest selection of models (especially Claude, Llama, Mistral) behind a single secure API.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service / Azure AI Foundry
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (standard) plus Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved dedicated capacity; batch and regional pricing variations.
key_features: Exclusive managed access to latest OpenAI models
Private networking via Azure Private Link / VNet
Azure Monitor and diagnostic audit logs, Entra ID RBAC
Fine-tuning of select OpenAI models
Content filtering / responsible AI guardrails
Deep Microsoft 365 / Copilot and Azure AI Foundry ecosystem integration
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-first organizations that want the newest GPT models with enterprise governance and tight M365/Azure integration.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for Gemini and third-party models; Provisioned Throughput sold in Generative AI Scale Units (GSUs) for reserved capacity (e.g. ~25 GSUs of Gemini 2.5 Flash ≈ 67,250 tokens/sec).
key_features: Gemini long-context models plus Claude/Llama in one catalog
VPC Service Controls and private endpoints
Cloud Audit Logs and IAM
Fine-tuning, distillation, and RAG (Vertex AI Search / grounding)
GSU-based provisioned throughput for predictable scale
Strong BigQuery and data/ML platform integration
platforms.best_for: Google Cloud / data-analytics-heavy enterprises wanting Gemini's long context alongside a broad model garden with strong MLOps.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Snowflake credits (compute) for LLM functions and Cortex features; no separate per-token vendor contract.
key_features: LLM inference runs next to governed data inside Snowflake perimeter
SQL/Python functions (COMPLETE, SUMMARIZE, SENTIMENT) and Cortex Analyst / Search
Role-based access control and Snowflake Horizon governance/audit
Fine-tuning via Cortex Fine-Tuning
Data never leaves the Snowflake account/region
Cortex Agents for data-grounded RAG
platforms.best_for: Data-centric enterprises that want to run GenAI directly on governed data already in Snowflake without moving it.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.pricing: Resource Unit (RU) / token-based consumption, plus subscription tiers; deployable on IBM Cloud, on-prem, or hybrid.
key_features: Hybrid and on-prem deployment (watsonx on Red Hat OpenShift)
IBM Granite open, indemnified models
watsonx.governance for audit, lineage, and risk/bias monitoring
Fine-tuning and prompt tuning (Tuning Studio)
Private networking and data isolation
Strong regulated-industry and AI governance focus
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises (banking, government, healthcare) needing hybrid/on-prem deployment, model indemnification, and strong AI governance.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-character/token on-demand plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved capacity; integrated with OCI Universal Credits.
key_features: Dedicated AI clusters for isolated, private inference and fine-tuning
Private networking within OCI VCN
OCI Audit and IAM access controls
Fine-tuning (T-Few / parameter-efficient)
Tight integration with Oracle Fusion/Database ecosystem
Sovereign cloud and EU/government regions
platforms.best_for: Oracle-centric enterprises and ERP/database shops wanting GenAI integrated with Oracle applications and sovereign cloud regions.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use based on 'neurons' (compute units) with a generous free tier; serverless, no capacity reservation.
key_features: Serverless edge inference on Cloudflare's global network (low latency)
AI Gateway for caching, rate limiting, logging, and multi-provider routing
Vectorize vector DB and R2/D1 integration for RAG
Regional/jurisdiction data localization controls
Request logging and analytics
Simple developer-first API, no GPU management
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing low-latency, globally distributed edge inference for open models and a multi-provider gateway.

platforms.name: Databricks Mosaic AI / Foundation Model APIs
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based (DBUs) for pay-per-token and provisioned throughput endpoints within the Databricks Lakehouse.
key_features: Inference co-located with Lakehouse/Delta data governed by Unity Catalog
Model Serving with provisioned throughput and external model gateway
Fine-tuning and custom model training (Mosaic AI Training)
Unity Catalog lineage, audit, and access governance
RAG and vector search integration
Agent and evaluation frameworks
platforms.best_for: Data/ML platform teams wanting to build and serve models and RAG apps directly on their Lakehouse-governed data.
